name: Microsoft Edge
statusNote: Actively developed with stable desktop and mobile releases.

availability.cpuNotes: Availability varies by operating-system release and architecture.

foundation.codeLicense: Chromium open-source components with Microsoft proprietary services

telemetry.note: Diagnostic data and personalization controls are documented in Edge settings.

trackerBlocking.note: Tracking Prevention is built in with Basic, Balanced, and Strict modes.

fingerprintingProtections.note: No broad hardened fingerprinting posture is claimed here.

privacy.privateWindows: InPrivate limits local records; it does not provide network anonymity.

vpnOrProxy.note: Edge documents a limited Secure Network feature in supported contexts.

manifestV2.note: Consumer Manifest V2 support is being disabled in phases from August 2026, with enterprise policy support ending in early 2027.

extensions.limitations: Some Chrome extensions may need explicit permission to install from the Chrome Web Store.

nativeContentBlocking.note: Tracking Prevention blocks categories of trackers, not every ad or tracker.

verticalTabs.note: Vertical tabs are a documented Edge feature.

workspaces.note: Edge Workspaces organize tabs and projects.

profiles.note: Profiles or equivalent browser identities are available.

splitView.note: Microsoft documents split screen: two side-by-side pages inside one tab.

sidebar.note: The Edge sidebar hosts tools and sites.

readerMode.note: Immersive Reader is a first-party feature from the address bar.

sync.note: Sync is provided by the browser or its upstream project.

pwa.note: Progressive web apps are supported by the Chromium install flow.

iosEngine.note: Apple permits alternative engines in the EU and Japan under entitlement; no non-WebKit build ships in the App Store.

assistant.note: Copilot provides a built-in assistant surface.

summarization.note: Copilot documents page or multi-tab summarisation.

agenticActions.note: Microsoft documents Copilot clicking, typing, and navigating tabs; consumer availability is gated to Microsoft 365 Premium subscribers in the United States.

aiSearch.note: Copilot documents AI-assisted answers in search or the address bar.

contentGeneration.note: Copilot documents text or image generation.

aiPrivacyControls.note: Copilot documents retention, training or kill-switch controls.

crossTabContext.note: Copilot documents awareness of multiple tabs or history.

voiceMultimodal.note: Copilot documents voice or image interaction.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

downloadManager.note: A built-in download manager is not documented.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.
